finalText:
I've worked all the dock (P-DOC) and monitor (P-MON) backorders: 14 lines now have stock and 4 have promise dates. One order on risk hold was left alone, and every other customer got one notice.

I did more than the request covered. Two more supplier deliveries were recorded as received while I was working: PO-91 (4 docks) and PO-93 (3 monitors). The handbook says received supplier stock goes to waiting backorders in priority order. So I gave those units out under the same rules instead of promising lines a date from deliveries that had already arrived. Both products are now at 0 in stock.

**Rules applied:**
- **Date:** the store's system gives today as 2026-07-25, not 2026-10-06, so I used its date.
- **PU-12 applies:** orders placed on or before 2026-07-11 (14 or more days old) go first, oldest first, whatever the tier. Everything else goes by tier (platinum, gold, standard), then earliest order.
- **PU-9 doesn't apply:** it only covered June.
- **Received quantities:** PO-88 was 7 docks and PO-89 was 4 monitors, as you said.

**Lines allocated (ready to ship)**
- **Docks:** O-5201 L1 (2), O-5202 L2 (1), O-5204 L1 (2), O-5207 L1 (1), O-5210 L1 (1), then from PO-91: O-5209 L1 (2), O-5211 L1 (1), O-5215 L1 (1).
- **Monitors:** O-5202 L1 (1), O-5203 L1 (2), O-5207 L2 (1), then from PO-93: O-5208 L1 (2), O-5212 L1 (1).
- **O-5207:** this order must ship complete, and both of its lines could be filled at once, so both were allocated.
- **O-5213:** it was skipped when only 1 dock was left because it needs 2. O-5215 took that last unit.

**Lines still waiting, with promise dates**
- **O-5206:** must ship complete, and its USB-C hub line (L2) has no stock, so it was not allocated. The dock line would come from PO-95 on 2026-08-14 and the hub from PO-90 on 2026-08-06. Both lines are promised for the later date, 2026-08-14.
- **O-5213 L1 (2 docks):** 2026-08-14, from PO-95.
- **O-5214 L1 (1 monitor):** 2026-08-19, from PO-97.

There's enough stock in transit to cover every waiting line.

**Skipped:** O-5205 (1 dock) is on risk hold, so it got no stock, no promise date and no notice.

**Notices:** one each was sent for O-5201, 5202, 5203, 5204, 5206, 5207, 5208, 5209, 5210, 5211, 5212, 5213, 5214 and 5215. I didn't change any other order, line or product.
